HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient seen and examined at bedside. 75-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.7, creatinine 0.99, hemoglobin 13.2, platelets 247, sodium 139, wbc 7.2; vitals dbp 64-69, heart_rate 75-78, map 88-91, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-16, sbp 134-137, spo2 97-99, temp 36.6-36.8
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.99, hemoglobin 13.2, platelets 241, sodium 138, wbc 7.2; vitals dbp 64-69, heart_rate 75-79, map 87-92, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-16, sbp 132-139, spo2 97-99, temp 36.6-36.8
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 75-year-old female, length of stay 4 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
